title: SvgImage
responsibility: Renders the native image element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgImage.attributes
inputs.description: Native image attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: SvgImage.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native image element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: SvgImage
outputs.description: The actual native image element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
